authority.scope: GTK2-only continuation and repair of the assistant's reversible R322 user-local install.

cause.r322: The user-local bundle replaced the GTK2 gtkrc in ~/.themes without updating the GTK2 adaptive-palette journal. The active journal still expected the prior wrapper, which coordinates ~/.themes and ~/.local/share/themes.
cause.discovery_paths: tools/components.py documents ~/.themes and the system theme directory as GTK2 theme lookup roots. tools/gtk2_palette_runtime.py separately owns wrapper gtkrc files in both XDG_DATA_HOME/themes and ~/.themes; the XDG copy is therefore part of the palette transaction even though it is not GTK2's theme lookup directory.

recovery.method: Bundle.restore() using the R322 transaction receipt and exact guarded backup

verification.test_scope: GTK2 palette runtime test module; does not prove historical pixel fidelity or XChat appearance

source_recipe.metrics: slider 11 px, stepper 15 px, trough border 2 px

installed_wrapper_fallback.metrics: slider 16 px, stepper 16 px, trough border 0 px; overridden by the generated palette include on GTK2 load

mame.status: ownership is not isolated; do not send guest input

next: Request visual review after a GTK2 application is reopened; do not restart or signal the open XChats. Resume held-state historical VM comparison only after MAME ownership is resolved.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: The rollback repaired the palette journal and confirmed the generated effective GTK2 recipe remains 15/11/2 with current KDE roles. Horizontal normal state is already pixel-matched; held states, live-app visual review, and historical VM comparison remain open.
